column1: # One content-relative bundle path per line. The card TITLE and TAGLINE are read from
# that landing's own _index.md frontmatter (title required; description -> tagline,
# shrunk to fit; no description -> title-only card). No taglines are stored here, so
# there is one source of truth (the page's frontmatter) and nothing to keep in sync.
# The home page (content/_index.md) is NOT listed here - it is a photo composite built
# by gen_home() from content/hoi-mug.jpg. Already carded by their own generators and
# Guard: scripts/check_social_cards.py enumerates every indexable _index.md landing and
# fails the build if one lacks a share-card, so a new landing added here-but-not-carded
# `posts` is the /blogs/ hub: Hugo requires a section index at
# content/<section>/_index.md, so the content path stays `posts` while the page
# is served at /blogs/ (blog-priv#62 AC 4.1/4.4). This file is keyed by CONTENT
# path, which is why the permalink move needed no change here.
# The 7 blog categories. Their descriptions are the SAME blurbs the /blogs/ hub
# body shows under each `## <Category>` heading, copied verbatim into each
# landing's own frontmatter (blog-priv#61) - so the hub page, the category
# page's meta description and its share-card tagline all read identically.
